definition: X is a pure extension of Zero when X's runtime is Zero's runtime plus added modules and capability packs, Zero never imports X-only code, no X module replaces, shadows or forks a Zero module, shared modules have no X-specific branches, X with no upgrade runs exactly Zero's tools and module closure, and X's added behavior enters only through declared extension points.
extensionPoints: self/host/boot-x.js: boots Zero's capsule at spark with the Optional upgrades selector and delegates to kernel/boot.js only when an upgrade above spark or a pre-capsule legacy instance is present
self/config/lab-upgrades.js LAB_UPGRADE_TOOL_SURFACE_IDS: the tool surfaces each X upgrade level adds, passed to shared/config/tool-surfaces.js as surfaceIds
self/config/genesis-levels.json: the modules each X upgrade level adds

divergences.reason: The two-file X route adapter that boots Zero's capsule on /x, renders the Optional upgrades selector defaulting to None: Zero core, and switches to the upgraded substrate only when an operator selects reflection..full.
